title: Pad
text: Pad or truncate specified dimension(s), 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Row size} sets Row length of output 1; {Pad over} sets the dimension over which to pad or truncate, {Dimensions to pad} sets the dimension over which to pad or truncate, {Pad value source} sets the source of pad value Specify, {Pad value}, {Output column mode} sets the mode of specifying column length, {Column size} sets the column length of output, {Output row mode} sets the mode of specifying row length, {Specify} sets the output size or pad, {Output size mode} sets the mode of specifying output length, {Output size} sets the output length along specified dimension, {Pad size at beginning} sets the number of values to add to beginning of input, {Pad size at end} sets the number of values to add to end of input, {Pad signal at} sets the where to pad or truncate and {Action when truncation occurs} sets the action to take when truncation occurs. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Input 1
ports.summary: Data input scalar | vector | matrix | N -D array

ports.name: Output 1
ports.summary: Padded or truncated output scalar | vector | matrix | N -D array

params.name: Pad over
params.values: Dimension over which to pad or truncate Columns (default) | Rows | Columns and rows | None | Specified dimensions

params.values: Source of pad value Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Pad size at end

params.values: Specify where to pad or truncate signal End (default) | Beginning | Beginning and end
